Definition: adverb from G4253; forwards, i.e. at a distance:--far, a great way off. See also G4207.
BiblicalUsage: Porrho means far off, at a distance. Jesus quotes Isaiah against the Pharisees: this people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me. Luke uses it for a king who sends an ambassage while his enemy is yet a great way off.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that distance from God is measured by the heart, not by miles, and lips can be near while the heart is far.
